guide.summary: Dead material that decomposers can eat.
guide.biology: Leftovers of dead organisms hold carbon and minerals that decomposers recycle.
guide.rules: Adds detritus carbon with 0.10 bound nutrient per carbon unit. Stationary. It never turns into living organisms by itself.
guide.example: Scatter debris near Recyclers and watch the Debris overlay (Lab → Observe) as they eat it; the “Debris (total)” chart in History shows the dish’s total.
